{{Quote|That Private Schor is a piece of work. Good shot, though.|Republic Soldier|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Schor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Private/Legends|Private]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Battle of Asylum]] he traveled to [[Odessen]] and joined the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]]. He was assigned to the military branch of the Alliance under [[Bey'wan Aygo]], where he frequently clashed with former [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Asani]] over their former affiliations. He was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] during the [[Crisis on Umbara]]. He was considered a good shot by his colleagues.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Private Schor first appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' in the [[Alliance base]] on Odessen.
